description: A single-use FPV quad with a shaped charge strapped under it. Launch it and stand still at its tablet: you fly it in first person (movement keys; up to 45 m away) until it hits something or you detonate it (Space or its key again). The blast hurts every hostile within 3.5 m (45 at the centre, less at the edge; elites and bosses shrug off most of it). The drone is spent. Draws 0.8 energy a second while it flies, 40 seconds at most. Relay Nine stock; Rask sells it in Dustline.
